EC1: - Having a history of operation due to scoliosis
EC2: - The deformity in the spine is rigid
EC3: - If the curvature [AND] measured in the spine is less than 10 degrees [OR] or more than 40 degrees in the patients whose operation decision is accepted by the family
EC4: - Having a seating modification applied at least 1 year before being included in the study
EC5: - Having a spasticity [OR] and contracture to [NOT] prevent sitting in the hip [AND] and knee joint
EC6: - Having a pressure ulcer to [NOT] prevent the patient from sitting
EC7: - the participant has comorbidity that is [NOT] not related about cerebral palsy
EC9: - Having bone operations for hip joints
